council.title: Student Council
council.subtitle: Share an idea, a problem or feedback with the people who represent you.
council.inviteText: Need help, have a suggestion, or want to share your thoughts? Send us an anonymous message. Your feedback helps us improve the platform and better support the 42 Prague community.
council.howWriteText: An idea, a problem or feedback for the council.
council.howReadText: Council members see the message, never who sent it.
council.howActText: They cannot reply to you directly: you stay anonymous.
council.tipText: Be specific: say what happened, where and when, so the council can act on it.
council.privacy: Your identity will NOT be shared with the council members. It is stored only to investigate abuse.
council.bodyLabel: Your message to the Student Council
council.privacyNoName: The council never sees who wrote the message.
council.privacyAbuse: Your identity is stored only to investigate abuse.
council.privacyNoReply: You don't get a copy, and nobody can reply to you directly.
council.tipLimit: You can send up to 10 messages per hour, so put everything in one message.
council.errorThrottled: You have sent too many messages. Please try again later.
council.errorSession: Your session has expired. Please log in again.
council.errorGeneric: Could not send your message. Please try again.
council.sentDelivered: Your anonymous message has been delivered.
council.sentNoReply: The council members cannot reply to you directly because your identity is hidden.
council.inboxSubtitle: New anonymous messages from your peers.
council.loadMessagesError: Could not load the messages. Please try again later.
council.caughtUpText: There are no new messages. The ones you have read are in the History.
council.howOpenText: Opening it does not mark it as read.
council.howMarkText: It moves to the History for every council member.
council.howNoteText: Coordinate in the shared note. The sender never sees it.
council.inboxTip: Messages are anonymous: nobody in the council can see who wrote them.
council.errorPermission: Only Student Council members can manage messages.
council.errorSomething: Something went wrong. Please try again.
council.missing: This message does not exist or was removed.
council.loadMessageError: Could not load the message. Please try again later.
council.notReadYet: Not read by the council yet
council.noteHint: Shared by all council members. Never shown to the sender.
council.conflictTitle: Another council member saved the note in the meantime.
council.conflictMerge: Your text is still in the box. Merge it and save again.
council.notePlaceholder: e.g. Forwarded to the building manager.
council.markedReadTitle: Done. You can now find the message in the History list!
